limits: Literal AST/docstrings only; no candidate import or execution.
A lexical test method is not a passing test or a runtime-discovered case.
The sole permitted original main callback assertion adapter is disclosed with exact before/after hashes, not awarded preservation credit.
Module/class/function documentation denominators are distinct; anonymous expressions are retained separately.
Frame call events are not invocation totals; generators/coroutines can emit resume events.
Executed def/class declarations are enclosing-code line evidence, never function-body call evidence.
Code-local instruction line opportunities are not statement, branch, path or complete-body coverage.
Nested declaration lines belong to the enclosing function's compiled code only.
Only four Python files in the primary interpreter thread are traced; worker threads and child Python/Git/Forge/Cargo processes are not traced.
This synthetic suite uses existing isolated Git and small Python subprocess controls; Cargo/Forge calls are mocked.
No maintained-client live conformance/Windows result, original failed-run recovery, F04 acceptance or human approval follows.
The full tracked-copy provenance is Root-supplied, not independently certified by this runner.

qualification: Exact-source pre-commit development measurement. Required enabled hook and current-head hosted checks are delivered separately.

unchanged_rust_coverage_binding.qualification: Exact unchanged tracked Rust and Cargo source only. Python/workflow coverage is measured separately; no new platform, branch or acceptance credit.
